prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the floor plan, transform the flat 2D architectural drawing into a polished 3D isometric dollhouse-style interior visualization. Preserve the original footprint, room divisions, wall angles, door/window positions, the two circular floor medallion locations, and the office room placement from the plan. Extrude the black plan walls into clean white waist-height interior walls and remove most measurement labels while keeping the faint AIAI.com watermark in the upper-left background. Add realistic architectural depth: gray polished concrete floors, white walls, glass storefront-style window/door openings along the exterior edges, soft sunlight, shadows, and a bright minimalist presentation on a plain light background. Furnish the layout as a modern home office showroom: add desks, shelving, display tables, storage cabinets, chairs, curtains, pendant lights, and small decor so each room feels functional, but keep the arrangement aligned to the original floor plan. Match the camera to a high three-quarter isometric view, showing the entire layout at once like a cutaway model. Style should be clean realistic architectural visualization with white, polished gray concrete, and warm natural lighting. Do not invent extra rooms, do not change the outer shape, and do not crop the building.

promptZh: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为平面图，将平面的 2D 建筑图纸转换为精致的 3D 等轴测“娃娃屋”风格室内可视化效果。保留原始占地面积、房间划分、墙体角度、门窗位置、两个圆形地面装饰位置以及图纸中的办公室布局。将黑色平面墙体拉伸为整洁的白色腰部高度内墙，并去除大部分尺寸标注，同时保留左上角背景中淡淡的 AIAI.com 水印。增加逼真的建筑深度：灰色抛光混凝土地面、白色墙体、沿外边缘的玻璃店面式门窗开口、柔和的阳光、阴影，以及在纯色浅色背景下的明亮极简展示。将布局布置为现代化的 家庭办公展厅：添加书桌、搁架、展示桌、储物柜、椅子、窗帘、吊灯和小型装饰，使每个房间都具有功能性，但保持陈设与原始平面图一致。将摄像机调整为高位四分之三等轴测视角，像剖面模型一样一次性展示整个布局。风格应为 整洁逼真的建筑可视化，采用 白色 墙面、抛光灰色混凝土 地面以及温暖的自然光照明。请勿凭空增加房间，请勿改变建筑外形，也请勿裁剪建筑边缘。
